source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 고문·집단학살·전쟁범죄·처형·성폭력·미성년자 대상 범죄·인신매매·테러 도 넣어줘. 안전 계약 관련된 부분은 이미지 모델 자체의 안전 장치를 사용할 거야. 이 스킬은 스킬로서의 기능에만 충실하면 돼. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently test the assigned deliberate fire-setting causality meaning in one declared-fictional, randomized, complex photographic scene while using the supplied portrait only for the visible appearance of a fictional adult fire investigator.
subject: An adult fire-setter, one blue-painted greenhouse service door, and a fictional adult fire investigator whose visible appearance is guided only by the supplied portrait.
setting: An early-1990s shuttered riverfront botanical greenhouse during freezing rain, with fogged glass panes and oxidized iron.
event: A fictional adult intentionally applies a flame to a single visible fuse path ending at one ignition point on the selected greenhouse door; fresh fire begins at that same point and expands outward as flame, smoke, and scorching.
visual_priorities: Keep the adult fire-setter, selected door, continuous ignition path, origin point, and outward fire consequence readable in one frame.
Keep the reference-guided fictional adult investigator secondary and visually separate from the fire-setter and selected property target.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a declared-fictional early-1990s municipal evidence photograph at a shuttered riverfront botanical greenhouse in freezing rain. The primary event is a deliberate fire-setting event: an adult fire-setter and one blue-painted greenhouse service door remain clearly visible. A lit cotton fuse runs coherently from the fire-setter's hand to one ignition point at the door base. Fresh orange flame begins exactly at that fuse-to-door point, while a small fan of new smoke and black scorching expands outward across the same door. In the near foreground, secondary to the event, a fictional adult fire investigator with long center-parted dark wavy hair, an oval face, dark eyes, and softly arched brows documents the scene with a compact evidence camera. She is visually separate from the fire-setter and the property target. Show fogged glass panes, oxidized iron frames, blue-hour river reflections, and freezing rain in a waist-height 28 mm documentary composition. Preserve readable spatial continuity from actor to ignition path to origin to outward result.
